options.name: become_user
options.description: The name of the user profile that the IBM i task will run under. Use this option to set a user with desired privileges to run the task.

options.name: become_user_password
options.description: Use this option to set the password of the user specified in C(become_user).

options.name: cmd
options.description: Specifies the command that runs in the submitted job.

options.name: frequency
options.description: Specifies how often the job is submitted.

options.name: job_name
options.description: Specifies the name of the job schedule entry.

options.name: joblog
options.description: If set to C(true), output the avaiable JOBLOG even the rc is 0(success).

options.name: parameters
options.description: The parameters that ADDJOBSCDE command will take. Other than options above, all other parameters need to be specified here. The default values of parameters for ADDJOBSCDE will be taken if not specified.

options.name: scddate
options.description: Specifies the date on which the job is submitted.

options.name: scdday
options.description: Specifies the day of the week on which the job is submitted. The valid value are C(*NONE), C(*ALL), C(*MON), C(*TUE), C(*WED), C(*THU), C(*FRI), C(*SAT), C(*SUN).

options.name: schtime
options.description: Specifies the time on the scheduled date at which the job is submitted.

options.name: text
options.description: Specifies text that briefly describes the job schedule entry.
